text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for dedicated pools in eu-west-1 (streaming endpoints). SLO p99 > 2.5s, currently 5.8s. Affected customers: 3 with high traffic. Paging on-call: @alice. docs/runbooks/dedicated-warmup.md
alice: I'm on it, looking at the pool dashboard now. seeing queue depth jump on pool-eu-west-1a → warmup lagging. starting live triage.
ben: I can join. any streaming stalls or just higher decode times? can you paste the slowest trace id?
alice: traces show long wait in handshake/slot allocation. streaming stalls observed (clients report stalled chunks). trace id: 0a3f2c
carla: runtime telemetry confirms KV cache cold path increased misses ~x6 and batch sizes dropped. autoscaler added 1 node but it was still initializing (warmup) — requests queued.
dom: product: which customers are impacted? we have one enterprise account with ongoing A/B; need to notify if customer-visible.
frank: support: already got 2 tickets from a customer in EU complaining about stalled generation. I opened a ticket and notified account lead.
eve: incident manager: can we mitigate quickly? options: manual capacity add, force fallback to hosted model variant, or throttle burst routing.
alice: immediate mitigation plan: 1) increase pool target by adding 2 hotshots in eu-west-1 (manual scale) 2) enable fallback routing to compatible smaller model for affected routes 3) prime KV cache on new nodes with warmup script. I'll run steps 1+3.
ben: I'll prepare fallback routing rule and config. Suggest route priority: (primary -> dedicated) then (fallback-hosted-small) with 50ms added header for observability.
carla: warmup script (what I'll run):
```
# prime kv caches and model init
curl -X POST https://internal-init/eu-west-1/warmup -d '{"model":"gptx-small","repeat":10}'
# validate kv hit rate
curl https://telemetry/kvcache?pool=eu-west-1
```
alice: starting manual scale now: `infra scale-pool --pool eu-west-1 --add 2 --type hotshot` — kicking off.
deploy-bot: scale job started: job_id=job-2026031501, expected ready ~90s. logs -> /jobs/job-2026031501
ben: fallback rule ready in draft, need approval from alice to flip. rule will match customer routes for the three affected customers only.
alice: approve fallback flip once new nodes are reporting healthy. currently 2 nodes launching, 1 init still pending.
frank: support: telling customer we've engaged engineering, mitigation underway, ETA ~5-10min. raising priority on active tickets.
eve: assign postmortem owner: @carla, please capture root cause and follow-up actions (playbook updates, autoscaler warmup hints).
carla: acked. will capture KV coldpath, autoscaler handshake delay, and consider pre-warm heuristics for known big customers.
alice: new nodes are `ready` -> running warmup script now. KV miss rate dropping from 90% to ~25% on those nodes.
ben: flipping fallback for affected customers now (one at a time) -> flipping customer A -> routing observed to fallback-hosted-small, latency for A improved to p99 ~1.2s. logs: `route-change: customer=A -> fallback-hosted-small`
alice: switching traffic off the most saturated pool lanes and enabling round-robin across new nodes.
carla: verifying streaming tail behavior: stalls reduced, chunk gap histogram tightened. p95 back to 450ms, p99 ~1.1s overall in eu-west-1.
frank: customer A confirms improvement on support thread. customer B still seeing intermittent stalls, B is next to be flipped.
eve: status update for execs in 10m. prepare one-line: "mitigated — manual scale + fallback routing; investigating autoscaler handshake delay and KV coldpath." dom please prepare customer comms draft.
dom: drafting comms: short note + promise of root cause within 72h and timeline for follow-ups. will share here in 8m.
alice: monitoring for regressions. keeping page open until stable 30m window. adding tags: severity=high, impact=customers-visible, mitigation=manual-scale+fallback
ben: suggestion for follow-up: autoscaler should consider node warmup time as part of scaling decision (don't count a node as available until KV warmed). adding to eng-runtime backlog.
carla: collecting traces and config for postmortem. saved trace bundle -> s3://redwood-incidents/1777777777/traces.tar.gz
deploy-bot: scale job job-2026031501 completed successfully, nodes warmed and marked healthy.
eve: moving to resolved when we hit stable p99 < 1.5s for 30m. if any regression, re-open paging. good job team.
frank: will update customers and close tickets once we hit stable window.
carla: postmortem action items (initial): 1) autoscaler: add warm-ready signal 2) runbook: add explicit warmup steps & prime script 3) observability: alarm on KV miss surge 4) routing: automated emergency fallback policy. I'll own #1 and #2.
alice: closing live triage in 26 minutes if stable — marking incident as mitigated now. incident-bot, tag as mitigated and create incident record.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated at 1777778250. p99 decreased to 1.1s. incident record created -> /incidents/1777777777
